title: New Initiative for Export Branding and Packaging

title: New DGFT Notification: Prohibition on Import of Goods Produced Using Forced Labour

body:
On July 13, 2026, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) released Notification 23/2026-27. This notification introduces important changes to the Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) 2023, specifically the insertion of Para 2.20B and Para 11.64. 

The key focus of this notification is the prohibition on importing goods produced using forced labour. This move aims to promote ethical trade practices and ensure that imported goods meet certain human rights standards. 

Importers and exporters across various sectors, including textiles, seafood, and chemicals, should take note of this development. It is crucial to ensure that your supply chains are compliant with these new regulations to avoid potential penalties or disruptions in trade. 

For more details, you can access the full notification [here](https://content.dgft.gov.in/Website/dgftprod/15ac9a16-6edb-432a-8f98-3bf2d0bf8bda/Notification%2023%20eng.pdf). Stay informed and ensure your business practices align with these new guidelines.

title: New DGFT Trade Notice: Electronic Filing for Preferential Certificate of Origin

body:

title: New Courier Imports and Exports Regulations Announced
